subject: ClearWave POC proposal & success criteria — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Shaw <tim.shaw@clearwave.ai>, Claire Reynolds <claire@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap from today + POC proposal

Hi Tim / Claire,

Thanks again for your time today — appreciate the candid discussion about ClearWave's ingestion bottlenecks and the priority on reducing end-to-end latency for transcript indexing.

Recap (high level):
- Goal: Reduce query latency for conversational search by 40% and surface higher-recall search results for customer support transcripts.
- Primary users: Support agents and triage automation pipeline.
- Constraints: Data residency in us-west, SSO + SCIM required, no external logging of raw transcripts.

Proposed next step: a 4-week POC focused on a narrow dataset (last 3 months of high-priority tickets, ~200k tokens/day). Objectives and success criteria below — would like to confirm these and propose owners/timeline.

Proposed evaluation playbook (summary):
1) Week 0 (kickoff): align data access, security checklist, and scope of subset.
2) Week 1-2: deploy trial model variant (quantized Llama-derived) in a private VPC, run ingestion and baseline evals.
3) Week 3: run A/B evaluation vs baseline search on precision@10 and median query latency.
4) Week 4: review, handoff, next steps (rollout or deeper pilot).

Success criteria (proposed):
- Median query latency reduced by >=35% under production-like QPS.
- Precision@10 uplift >=7 percentage points on a sampled testset.
- No raw transcript telemetry leaves your VPC; audit logs available.

Owners (tentative): Redwood: Ben (technical lead), Monica (POC coordination), Jonas (infra/runbook). ClearWave: Tim (project sponsor), Claire (engineering lead).

Attachments: evaluation-checklist.xlsx (sheet with proposed metrics), clearwave-poc-sow.pdf (scope & SOW stub).

Next steps: if the above looks right, can we lock in kickoff the week of Apr 19? Please reply with any edits to scope, success metrics, or timing.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter

From: Claire Reynolds <claire@clearwave.ai>

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today + POC proposal

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our internal notes. A few clarifications from our side:
- The dataset scope is OK but we'd prefer to start with a smaller pilot (30k tokens/day) to validate the pipeline, then step up to the full slice in week 2.
- Success metrics: we care about latency at the 95th percentile (p95) more than median; can we include p95 <= 450ms as a target?
- Compliance: we need a signed DPA and confirmation that the trial can run in our AWS account (VPC endpoint) — we cannot allow egress of raw logs.

Dates: Week of Apr 19 works; our eng team is available Apr 19-21 for kickoff and preliminary data access.

Owners: I'll be primary eng contact (Claire). Tim will sponsor budget/approval.

Please update the playbook with the p95 target and the phased ramp. Once updated we'll route the SOW internally and execute the DPA.

Claire

Claire Reynolds

Claire / Tim,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per Claire's notes we've updated the evaluation playbook and phased ramp. High-level final plan below and attached SOW + checklist:

Updated highlights:
- Phase 1 (Week 1): pilot ingest at ~30k tokens/day in your AWS account (private VPC).
- Phase 2 (Weeks 2-3): scale to the target slice and run A/B evaluations (precision@10 and p95 latency).
- Targets: median latency improvement >=35% and p95 <= 450ms under negotiated QPS in the trial window; precision@10 uplift >=7pp.
- Compliance: Redwood will not transmit raw transcripts off your VPC; audit logs will be pushed to your logging bucket. We will provide the DPA and a one-page security checklist.

Attachments included: clearwave-poc-sow.pdf, evaluation-checklist.xlsx. Drive link with the runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cClearWavePOC

Next steps (actionable):
- Tim: confirm budget sponsor OK, aim to sign SOW + DPA by Apr 16.
- Claire: confirm kickoff slot Apr 19 @ 10am PT or propose alternate time.
- Redwood (Ben/Jonas/Monica): we'll send the VPC onboarding checklist and a short runbook prior to kickoff.

If that all looks good I'll attach the SOW to the HubSpot deal and schedule the kickoff calendar invite.

Best,
Monica
